metaDescription: BPI Sp 3 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. About 120 days to harvest, 14.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: BPI Sp 3 is a registered sweet potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1985. It takes about 120 days from planting to harvest, with 14.9 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about BPI Sp 3 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

BPI Sp 3 sweet potato takes about 120 days from planting to harvest. That is 5.5 days longer than the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 14.9 t/ha matches the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant BPI Sp 3 sweet potato

It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.
